Wingless.hypothesis: Validate frozen W selected checksum with identical-score cached versus uncached algorithm and strong fixed under one matched runner runtime+memory measurement; report resource budget eligibility instead of pretending cost parity.

benchmark.measure: perf_counter_ns wall; tracemalloc peak; alternating seeded fixed arm order for fairness; per-graph paired comparisons, median and p95; include measured per-run source/hash and hardware details

Wingless.policy: If memory OR runtime budget exceeds strong fixed, record RESOURCE_NOT_MATCHED, disallow superiority claim. Same-checksum indexed versus uncached isolates index speed and extra memory.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: New FIT-only depth-conditioned readout of frozen centered V output can separate true/false without touching 7+9 cells or model weights.
Yggdrasil.fit: Observe frozen V logits from positive+negative public FIT pairs only, choose one (intercept,slope) pair from frozen grid maximizing paired exact classification. tie: prefer intercept=0 and slope=0 by smallest (abs intercept+abs slope), then intercept then slope ascending. Train no other layers; DEV never inspected before final selection.
Yggdrasil.evaluation: paired 48 DEV, FP/FN counts, per-depth 16, margins and matched original logit and operation counters. Source-blind prediction.
